2123894067969081354.en_summary: $BX Blackstone President and COO Jon Gray: I grew up in suburban Chicago. I'd never been to the East Coast until college at University of Pennsylvania. Made one really good decision to get a dual degree, English major and Wharton finance. Met a young woman in romantic poetry class, got a job at a small investment advisory firm in New York. 35 years later, with the same woman and working at the same firm. Luck is a core competency. When I joined Blackstone, there were 70 people, managed one LBO fund for $750 million. Today the firm manages $1.4 trillion. I feel incredibly lucky and it energizes me every day.
2123894067969081354.zh_summary: $BX Blackstone總裁兼首席營運官Jon Gray：我在芝加哥郊區長大。上賓夕法尼亞大學之前從未去過東海岸。做了一個很好的決定，取得雙學位，英語專業和沃頓金融。在浪漫詩班認識一位年輕女子，幾週後在紐約一家小型投資顧問公司找到工作。35年後，與同一位女士在一起，在同一家公司工作。運氣是核心競爭力。加入Blackstone時只有70人，管理一個7.5億美元的LBO基金。今天公司管理1.4萬億美元。我感到非常幸運，這每天都激勵我。
